answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across identities: if k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, the slashing penalty grows quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an additional exponential capital-loss multiplier makes larger swarms disproportionately costly, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery. Thus a meadow of aliases, whether named copper or willow, cannot cheaply amplify voting power.
